question_text: Read the following passage and answer the given subquestions:  Writing in a diary is a really strange experience for someone like me. I feel like writing, and I have an even greater need to get all kinds of things off my chest.  ‘Paper has more patience than people.’ I thought of this saying on one of those days when I was feeling a little depressed and was sitting at home with my chin in my hands, bored and listless, wondering whether to stay in or go out.
